panels.description: Number of workflows currently in Pending or Running. This is the main at-a-glance workload indicator for the cluster.
panels.title: Active Workflows

panels.description: Number of workflows currently in the Pending phase. A high count may indicate resource constraints, scheduling issues, or parallelism limits.
panels.title: Pending Workflows

panels.description: Number of workflow-created pods currently running. Compare with running workflows to assess parallelism.
panels.title: Running Pods

panels.description: Number of workflows that reached a terminal phase in the past 6 hours. Use this to gauge recent throughput.
panels.title: Workflow Completions [6h]

panels.description: Percentage of completed workflows succeeding over the past 6 hours. No data means no completed workflows in that window.
panels.title: Success Rate [6h]

panels.description: Number of workflows currently in Failed or Error. Any sustained non-zero value deserves investigation.
panels.title: Unhealthy Workflows

panels.description: Distribution of currently active workflows across phases (Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed, Error). A healthy system shows mostly Running and Succeeded workflows.
panels.title: Current Workflows

panels.description: Distribution of workflow completions by phase over the past 6 hours. High proportions of Failed or Error phases indicate systemic issues.
panels.title: Workflow Completions [6h]

panels.description: Distribution of workflow-created pods across phases. High Pending counts may indicate scheduling issues or resource constraints.
panels.title: Current Pods
Time objects spend waiting in the queue

panels.description: Percentage of workflows completing successfully over each dashboard rate interval. Drops below expected levels indicate workflow logic errors, infrastructure issues, or resource constraints.
panels.title: Workflow Success Rate

panels.description: Workflows reaching each terminal phase within each interval. This shows throughput and where recent workflow outcomes are landing.
panels.title: Workflow Completions by Phase

panels.description: Top busiest namespaces based on the number of workflows succeeded or failed.
panels.title: Top busiest namespaces 6h

panels.description: Top namespaces with more number of failures
panels.title: Top namespaces by failures 6h

panels.description: Duration of workflow reconciliation operations. Rising latency indicates controller overload, API server slowness, or complex workflow processing. P99 spikes precede visible degradation.
panels.title: Workflow Operation Duration

panels.description: Pods entering pending state within each interval, grouped by reason. Helps identify scheduling or resource issues behind pod backlog.
panels.title: Pods Entering Pending

panels.description: Pods reported missing within each interval. Spikes may indicate aggressive eviction, node failure, or resource pressure.
panels.title: Missing Pods
Pods Running and Pending Over Time
